method: session-aware paired randomization test on Delta_I
mathematical_justification: Under H0 (observed imagery reliability is fully explained by cue+post-video+nuisance contamination), the imagery video-label assignment within each imagery SESSION is exchangeable conditional on the design and the contamination prediction; permuting video labels within session (preserving session, trial counts, video counts, temporal structure) yields a valid null for R_I, and Delta_I inherits it because R_I_cuevideo_predicted is a fixed function of the cue/post-video/nuisance regressors (no true imagery content, proven by test_forward_contamination_has_zero_true_imagery). Session-disjoint splitting keeps the exchange unit = imagery session, so paired session-aware randomization is valid.
resampling_scheme: within-imagery-session video-label permutation (identical to the sealed R_I null); no cross-session label exchange; non-straddling
fallback_if_not_exchangeable: NOT triggered (exchangeability holds); the sealed conservative hierarchical-bootstrap/sensitivity criterion would apply only if it did not
synthetic_validation: forward-contamination operator proven to carry EXACTLY zero true-imagery contribution (unit test); permutation wiring proven within-session and non-straddling (unit tests)
